title: V3 Question Types Demo
description: One question of each V3 type: balancing, electron configuration, periodic-table pick, significant figures, sorting into groups, labelling a diagram, and reading and plotting a graph.

title: V4 Question Types Demo A
description: Multi-part, naming (both directions) and dropdown cloze questions, plus the per-question extras: a hint that costs points and a "How sure are you?" row.

title: V4 Question Types Demo B
description: One question of each of five more V4 types: dimensional analysis, nuclear notation, predicting products, molecular shape, and completing a table.

title: V4 Question Types Demo C
description: Molar mass, picture choice, particle diagram, titration and estimate questions, plus algorithmic questions where every student gets their own numbers.

title: V5 Question Types Demo
description: One question of each V5 type: Bohr shells, oxidation numbers, solubility, heating curve, gas law, molecule builder, ion builder, ionic formula and isotope mass.
